title: A Hollow for the Oath
author: S. M. Fairweather
blurb: Paloma Hartwell, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
